title: Cambrian lattices are fractionally Calabi-Yau via 2-cluster combinatorics
summary: Reading constructed a Cambrian lattice $C_Γ$ for each oriented finite type Coxeter diagram $Γ$. We show that the derived category of representations of $C_Γ$ is fractionally Calabi-Yau for any $Γ$, confirming a conjecture of Chapoton. This extends a result of Rognerud for Cambrian lattices of type $A$ with linear orientation, better known as Tamari lattices. If $Γ$ is crystallographic, then $C_Γ$ is given by the lattice of torsion classes of any hereditary algebra $Λ$ of type $Γ$.
